description: Planted Tweedie-like twin of R2: zero-inflated, log-normal positive part (heavy tail).
sizingNote: 25,000 rows (Ruling Q9: >= 20,000, heavy tail). About 43% are positive (10,823); with logSd 1.0 the positive part's coefficient of variation is 1.31, so the positive-part mean has SE about 1.3% and the log-scale betas have SE 0.01 to 0.02. The maximum Target is about 100x the mean, which is the heavy tail a squared-error objective mishandles.
